formal_mechanism.cut: B is the frozen parent canonical variable-only mincut; parent must return OPEN_MINCUT_BRANCH_BUDGET with zero branch enumeration
formal_mechanism.component_anchor: For each cut-separated component C, choose canonically among relations whose scope contains all B: minimum allowed-row count, then canonical relation id/index tie-break
formal_mechanism.candidate_cut_states: S_C is the set of B-projections of anchor rows; |S_C| <= anchor rows <= L; never enumerate {0,1}^B
formal_mechanism.join_tree_discovery: Build a deterministic maximum-weight spanning tree on relation nodes using |scope_i intersect scope_j| with deterministic tie-breaks; verify running-intersection for every variable. Failure returns OPEN, not search/backtracking.
formal_mechanism.conditional_component_test: For each sigma in S_C, restrict every relation only by the B variables it contains, then perform exact two-pass semijoin reduction on the verified tree. Nonempty reduced tables imply an exact component witness; empty table implies sigma infeasible for C.
formal_mechanism.component_boundary_support: P_C = { sigma in S_C : restricted component join is nonempty }
formal_mechanism.exact_equivalence: F is SAT iff H is nonempty for the frozen scope
formal_mechanism.reconstruction: Choose sigma in H; for each component reconstruct one compatible relation row per tree node from semijoin-reduced tables; merge on running-intersection separators and the common cut; cut-separated private variables are disjoint across components
formal_mechanism.output_bound: |P_C| <= |S_C| <= anchor input rows <= L and |H| <= min_C |P_C|
formal_mechanism.construction_bound: At most L anchor states per component; each state uses polynomial pairwise semijoin comparisons over explicit rows and scopes; total polynomial in original explicit input length

negative_controls.reason: Three relation scopes form a private-variable cycle after removing B; deterministic tree must fail running-intersection and may not backtrack/search for a semantic shortcut.
Do not synthesize cut states by cross-product when no explicit relation already exposes the full B.

complexity_claim.anchor_discovery: Linear scan of component relation scopes and row counts
complexity_claim.candidate_states: At most explicit anchor rows, hence O(L), not 2^|B|
complexity_claim.join_tree_construction: Polynomial weighted graph construction plus deterministic Kruskal tree and polynomial running-intersection verification
complexity_claim.semijoin: For each candidate state, two tree passes; naive tuple compatibility checking is polynomial in explicit row counts and arity
complexity_claim.carrier_storage: At most anchor-row count states per component; no full join output materialization
complexity_claim.global_intersection: Polynomial set intersection of component supports
complexity_claim.reconstruction: One compatible original input row per relation node for one accepted sigma
